_comment: Hand-written input of `cargo xtask attributions`, which merges it with docs/PORTS.md, li-seg's MODELS, SAM 3, the li-ai family profiles and Cargo.lock into assets/attributions.json (the file the app shows in Settings / Preferences / About › Attributions). Edit this file for assets, data and projects that have no machine-readable source; never edit assets/attributions.json by hand. Sections appear in this order; generated entries come before the ones listed here. licence_files are paths from the repository root and are built into the app.

app.name: Local Image
app.used_for: A layered raster editor, photo library and raw developer with local AI, written in Rust.
